criteria.threshold_change_justification: Retained the original 0.100 m position RMSE target from the pilot report without relaxation; added explicit P90 (0.150 m), max (0.200 m), time-grid (1e-6 s), zero missing contact observations, and <=5% binary contact-state disagreement criteria before executing the 40-trace held-out campaign.
